sub_sector.value: payment card manufacturing; instant issuance and card fulfillment services; prepaid card programs

manufacturing_type.detail: Produces and personalizes individual payment cards, plus fulfillment, at U.S. facilities.

production_model.detail: Cards personalized to customer program orders, with no customer inventory management needed.

product_complexity.detail: Secure, personalized payment cards with chips, metal options and wallet provisioning.

production_role.detail: Supplies cards and issuance services directly to banks, fintechs and processors.

end_market_exposure.detail: Banks, credit unions, fintechs and prepaid programs in financial services and payments; retail prepaid cards.

notes: Production model and complexity inferred from card personalization and security requirements; digital issuance and software are secondary.
